parent_objective: audit repeat checkpoint/workload materialization before repeat measured execution design
blocked_by: M2177 repeat materialization must be audited before measured execution command design
supersedes: direct repeat measured execution after materialization

public_gates: M2178 must audit M2177 summary and repeat group rows
M2178 must confirm two new repeat workloads have 640 existing checkpoint paths
M2178 must confirm reset-control did not train separately
M2178 must not run measured execution or rank profiles
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits repeat materialization before measured repeat execution design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: repeat materialization audit only; no measured execution ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if repeat workloads are missing or incomplete
stop if checkpoint paths are missing
stop if reset-control alias policy is violated
stop if audit would rank profiles
fallback_plan: route to repeat materialization repair if audit fails
route to repeat measured execution command design if audit passes
route to synthesis if the current branch reaches cadence

admission_evidence: M2177 writes repeat group and profile checkpoint rows
allowed_updates: M2178 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for repeat measured execution command design or materialization repair

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2178 audits repeat materialization and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2178.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If repeat materialization is invalid, repair materialization before measured execution.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits newly materialized repeat panel before producing repeat rollout data
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit repeat measured execution design but cannot decide final comparison

hypothesis: The M2177 repeat materialized panel is clean enough to admit repeat measured execution command design while keeping ranking blocked.
success_criteria: no measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: any repeat workload checkpoint path is missing or nonexistent
decision_rule: M2178 passes if it audits M2177 as clean repeat materialization evidence and routes to measured execution command design without running it.
